environment: Hermes Native Rust Gateway WebSocket fixture and headless egui/AccessKit tests; no live Hermes Gateway, installed Windows UI, credentials or physical input used.
notes: Gateway test asserts the exact profile-scoped mcp.catalog method, parses connector_slug when present and omits it when absent, validates required environment-key names, and rejects malformed entries. App test checks loading and refresh semantics, installed/enabled and available catalog rows, shared search, stale authority/profile response rejection, visible error and empty states. Cache test verifies the five-minute refresh boundary. Full command cargo test -p hermes-native --features agent-automation --locked passed 421 library tests, 15 automation protocol tests, 3 launcher tests and doc tests; cargo check, rustfmt, progress generators, task validator, UCM package validator and diff check passed. Live/remote Gateway, packaged Windows behavior and source-paired acceptance remain open; installation is a separate capability.
